company.name: ZEIGO Services
company.headline: Your reliable partner in keeping things clean, safe, secure, and on the move.
company.overview: ZEIGO SERVICES is a professional business services partnership firm with proven expertise in multiple industries such as travel, event management and housekeeping facility services etc. We have a associated team members who have domain experience for more than 15 years. Zeigo Services is partnership firm founded in 2017.
company.vision: To become the most trusted, respected, and reliable commercial manpower company in Navi Mumbai as well as PAN India. Our vision is to create environments where people feel completely safe and comfortable. By seamlessly blending the arts of professional housekeeping and vigilant security, we aim to be the silent partner that provides total peace of mind. With a foundation built on eight years of dedicated service, we aspire to transform every facility we touch into a pristine, secure, and welcoming space, allowing our clients to focus on what matters most to them.
company.mission: To help our clients have productive, safer, and healthier environments through a robust range of cleaning services, industry-leading standards, and sustainable business practices. Our mission is to provide our clients with complete peace of mind by offering reliable and responsive housekeeping and security solutions. Leveraging our 8 years of hands-on experience, we listen to our clients' unique needs to craft tailored service plans that work.
